concepts.label: Atmosphere is a layer of gases held by gravity
quotes: Earth's atmosphere is a layer of gases held in place by gravity.

concepts.label: Atmosphere composition
quotes: Dry air is about 78 percent nitrogen and about 21 percent oxygen.
Argon makes up most of the remaining 1 percent.

concepts.label: Five layers of the atmosphere
quotes: Scientists divide the atmosphere into five layers.
Starting at the ground and going up, they are the troposphere, the stratosphere, the mesosphere, the thermosphere and the exosphere.

concepts.label: Lithosphere is not an atmosphere layer
quotes: The lithosphere is not a layer of the atmosphere: it is the rocky outer shell of the Earth itself.

concepts.label: Troposphere weather and temperature
quotes: The troposphere is where almost all weather happens.
In the troposphere, the air usually gets colder as you go higher.

concepts.label: Stratosphere contains the ozone layer
quotes: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs harmful ultraviolet light from the Sun.

concepts.label: Mesosphere burns meteors
quotes: The mesosphere is where most meteors burn up.

concepts.label: Thermosphere has auroras and the ISS
quotes: The thermosphere is where auroras appear and where the International Space Station orbits.

concepts.label: Troposphere thickness
quotes: The troposphere is about 12 kilometres thick on average, thinner at the poles and thicker at the equator.

concepts.label: Exosphere is outermost and fades into space
quotes: The exosphere is the outermost layer, where the atmosphere gradually fades into space.
